package.name: arm_peripherals
package.description: Nodes that control the arm's end-effector tool (gripper/claw/drill/lock) via CAN bus. Talks to the ESP32 tool firmware over can_msgs/Frame on /to_can_bus and /from_can_bus (see ros2_socketcan, brought up by rover_bringup/can.launch.py) rather than opening SocketCAN itself — same pattern rover_peripherals already uses for the rover's lights/ power-monitor ESP32 peripherals.
